name: com.lemolatoon.udoncl
description: Transaction-safe Unity import for udoncl programs, Device kernels, UdonDNN/UdonBLAS, and compiled ONNX models with generated U# bindings.

samples.description: Call a Host C export that launches an OpenCL C kernel, then read its result back from U#.
Classify a hand-drawn digit with the MNIST CNN ONNX model through its generated U# binding.
Chat with TinyLlama-1.1B through a user-built 4096-token Chat Artifact and stream its replies.
